title: GBN-AG accompanying document types
description: The document types a notifier can attach to a GBN-AG pre-notification, used as the value space for exchangedDocument.referenceDocument[].typeCode. A static list: where a UN/CEFACT UNTDID 1001 code fits a document type, the code is copied in; the three types UNTDID 1001 has no code for are given Defra codes GBN1 to GBN3. The list does not reference any other codelist. 916 (Related document) is the code for a notifier who chooses "Other"; it is never a default. All codes are strings. Values are listed with the UNTDID 1001 codes first in numerical order, then the Defra codes in numerical order. This file is the working source of truth in the absence of a live Defra reference-data service; when that service goes live at https://refdata.tbc.defra.gov.uk/, this file is retired and the URL stays the same.

values.label: Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)
values.description: UNTDID 1001 Inspection certificate. TRACES sends 856 for the EU INTRA certificate ("Inspection certificate (EU Intra Certificate)"); see defra-unvtd-profile-intra-v1.schema.json.

values.label: Other
